brief.headline: Binance suffers record $6.3 billion crypto hack
brief.detail: More than $6 billion in crypto was stolen from Binance, and investigators are racing to recover funds before North Korea-linked hackers can launder them.

brief.headline: Anthropic files for IPO as AI risks mount
brief.detail: Anthropic has finally filed for an IPO, while rising risks have not yet slowed the AI buildout, according to SiliconANGLE.

brief.headline: Intel stock posts worst day in over 50 years
brief.detail: Intel shares headed for their worst day in more than 50 years, wiping $12 billion off the government's stake, as investors worry about AI spending payoffs.

brief.headline: Amazon and Intel results deepen tech selloff
brief.detail: Disappointing results from Amazon and Intel intensified the tech selloff and worries around the AI trade, with the Nasdaq composite slumping more than 2%.

brief.headline: Nasdaq 100 heads for third correction this year
brief.detail: Investors dumped big tech stocks after a slew of disappointing earnings, putting the Nasdaq 100 on course for its third technical correction of 2026.
